November has been packed with events and webinars, and there’s one more coming up. Next Tuesday, November 24, join us for “Stop Hand-Tuning MySQL: Teaching a Kubernetes Operator to Do It for You” with Kate Obiidykhata (Percona).
 
Come say hi, ask questions, let’s talk MySQL.
 
All the details are on the event page: https://oursqlfoundation.org/community/webinars/autopilot-mysql-kubernetes-operator/
 
Don’t forget to register.
#MySQL #Kubernetes #OurSQLFoundation
